headline: Afreximbank Reports 24% Rise in Nine-Month Net Income
summary: African Export-Import Bank reported net income of $813.5 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, driven by strengthened net interest income.
why: Afreximbank plays a crucial role in financing and facilitating intra- and extra-African trade. Its earnings reflect broader commercial credit demand and financing conditions across emerging African markets.

impacts.name: African Banking
impacts.why: Higher net interest income drove a 24% profit increase for the multilateral trade finance institution.
